Generate the correction tables and views for a master's sources

Source: R/source_corrections.R
generate_corrections_sql.Rd

Writes, for each source declared in master.yml, a <source>.tables.sql file that creates its corrections and decisions tables once, and a <source>.views.sql file that creates or replaces its four views:

Usage

generate_corrections_sql(config, con, dir, dialect = "mssql")

Arguments

config

A master_config from read_master_config(), with sources.

con

A DBI connection that can see the source views.

dir

Character. An existing directory to write the files into.

dialect

"mssql" or "duckdb".

Value

The written paths, invisibly.

Details

  • <source>_corrected: the source with accepted corrections applied, covering every column, so a first correction to a column is live with no redeployment.

  • <source>_corrections_applied: which correction applied to which row.

  • <source>_corrections_stale and <source>_corrections_conflicts: for data management.

Statements are separated by GO lines, as sqlcmd expects. Regenerate the views whenever the source view's columns change. Data engineering deploys the files.

Interim. Superseded by the HVTR registry, which takes over the tables unchanged.

See also

propose_corrections(), decide_corrections()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE)) {
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "stg_demo", data.frame(mrn = "SYN1", lvef = 30))
  cfg_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
  writeLines(c("name: master_demo", "key: [mrn]", "snapshots: snaps",
               "current: x.sas7bdat", "build_program: x.sas",
               "sources:", "  stg_demo: {key: [mrn]}"), cfg_path)
  generate_corrections_sql(read_master_config(cfg_path), con, tempdir(),
                           dialect = "duckdb")
  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
}
